reason: A DeepSeek Harness UI workbench for reviewing AI code changes through diff panels, file history, workspace navigation, conversation turn navigation, and workspace-scoped file editing.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码审阅工作台，集中展示每轮文件差异、工作区状态、对话轮次导航，并支持在工作区内编辑文件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness code-review workbench that presents per-turn file diffs, workspace status, conversation navigation, and workspace-scoped file editing.

capabilities: Reads persisted conversation logs and workspace file state
Reads Git status and diffs without modifying Git
Displays reconstructed per-turn file changes and diffs
Writes edits to files within the selected workspace
